# rubrik_azure_kms_key_manager (Data Source)

The `rubrik_azure_kms_key_manager` data source is used to look up a single Azure
key vault key manager registered in RSC, by name or by ID.

A key manager is a stored connection profile giving RSC access to a customer
owned key management service. Its ID is generated by RSC and is the value
archival locations refer to the key manager by, alongside the name and version
of the key itself, which come from Azure.

~> **Note:** Key managers are registered in the RSC UI, under Settings,
   Security, Encryption Management. There is no Terraform resource for
   registering one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an Azure key vault key manager by the name it was registered with in
# RSC.
data "rubrik_azure_kms_key_manager" "production" {
  name = "Production Azure Key Vault"
}

# A key manager can also be looked up by ID, to read the rest of its details.
data "rubrik_azure_kms_key_manager" "by_id" {
  id = "8d2d0ee8-6b5a-4a58-b2a1-cd0b5f4ee2a4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) RSC key manager ID (UUID). This is the value archival locations refer to the key manager by. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be specified.
- `name` (String) Key manager name. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) Azure client ID.
- `cloud_account_id` (String) RSC cloud account ID backing the key manager. Empty unless `provisioning_method` is `CLOUD_ACCOUNT_PROVISION`.
- `data_locations_count` (Number) Number of data locations encrypted with keys from this key manager.
- `description` (String) Key manager description.
- `key_vault_url` (String) Key vault URL.
- `natural_id` (String) Identifies what the key manager connects to, rather than the key manager itself: the key vault URL.
- `provisioning_method` (String) How RSC obtains the credentials it reaches the key vault with. Possible values are `CLOUD_ACCOUNT_PROVISION`, `DIRECT_PROVISION` and `SECURE_PROVISION`.
- `region` (String) Azure region of the key vault.
- `tenant_id` (String) Azure tenant ID.
